propositions: docs/event-schema.md statically enumerates six LINK relations and omits the supported caused_by relation, while src/rebar/graph/_links.py:CANONICAL_RELATIONS contains seven canonical relations including caused_by
The caused_by relation is directional, non-blocking, and non-cycle-inducing, per the closed design authority isogonal-wedged-catfish, but event-schema documentation does not state these properties

The documented LINK inventory diverged from the cited canonical source due to manual duplication across commits; commit 901241b218 added caused_by to code surfaces but not docs/event-schema.md, and commit 693a6bf412 rewrote the row retaining only six relations
A documentation contract test must enforce set equality between the parsed event-schema LINK inventory and CANONICAL_RELATIONS to prevent future relation omissions
